authority: Registered House Tang development packages. Mutable project state remains in House Tang, Sword Manor, treasury, population, runtime and candidate-pool owners.

sword_manor_expansion.rule: Start cost must fit the current House treasury-safe discretionary ceiling. Existing spare housing may be used immediately after the House raises trainee authorization; construction capacity is not usable before completion. Standards are unchanged.

sword_manor_operating_costs.rule: Recurring trainee program cash and food requirements scale from exact current trainee headcount. Stable House flow summaries must be recomputed whenever Sword Manor trainee headcount changes.

great_bow_guard_recruitment.application_representation: Regional applications are nonresident records over still-conserved civilian population. Only the 12,000-person residential trial shortlist is reserved into the candidate pool.
great_bow_guard_recruitment.rule: Great Bow Guard recruitment is a two-level funnel. House Tang may canvass and screen up to 120,000 regional applicants using registered selection and paid administrative work without removing those applicants from civilian population. The best 12,000 are represented by the conserved residential candidate cohort, after which the ordinary final trial may reduce them to the 3,000-person fighting establishment. The campaign's 15 retained source/background cohorts are preserved and normalized to 200 fighters each instead of inventing extra cohorts. Opening or screening creates no fighter, equipment issue, formation, officer appointment or accepted headcount.
